summary: Iteration-6 focus: verify 3 frontend fixes (QuickWheels approved, Paid/Free segmented control, time-slot dedupe) + full Automobile end-to-end + reschedule + regressions. FRONTEND FIXES 1/3 (QuickWheels visible on /category/Automobile alongside Nandi auto mobiles) VERIFIED. FRONTEND FIX 2/3 (Paid/Free segmented control) VERIFIED — data-testid 'booking-service-type-paid' and 'booking-service-type-free' render as a 2-column segmented control, Paid is selected by default (bg-forest-faint border-forest ring-2 classes), and clicking sets serviceType state. The POST payload now correctly ships service_type='Paid'. FRONTEND FIX 3/3 (time-slot dedupe) VERIFIED — /slots for QuickWheels still returns 2 duplicate shifts (09:00-18:00 twice) but BookSlot.jsx L79 `Array.from(new Set(out)).sort()` dedupes them: 12 unique buttons (9:00 AM…5:15 PM) with zero duplicates. Non-automobile regression (Sharma Clinic Healthcare) VERIFIED — no Vehicle Details section shown. Role routing regression (customer→/, provider 8888800884→/provider, receptionist 6666600011→/receptionist, admin 7777700002→/admin) all VERIFIED with bottom nav on customer/provider/receptionist. HOWEVER, the Automobile end-to-end AND reschedule are STILL BLOCKED by a backend bug: POST /api/bookings returns 400 {"detail":"Selected shift is not available"} for QuickWheels on EVERY date+time combination except the already-taken 2026-07-01 09:00 (which returns 409). Verified with WED 1 Jul 3:00 PM, THU 2 Jul 12:45 PM, and MON 6 Jul 10:30 AM — all fail with the same 400. GET /api/providers/{id}/slots?date=2026-07-06 returns has_schedule=true with both shifts marked available=true & is_past=false, so /slots and POST /bookings disagree. Because no booking is created, the reschedule flow could not be exercised for the automobile provider.

critical.issue: Returns 400 {'detail':'Selected shift is not available'} for ALL date+time combinations, even future dates where GET /providers/{id}/slots reports has_schedule=true and shifts[].available=true. Verified request payload is well-formed: {provider_id, service_id:'5e4a9897-dd6b-4bcc-80db-2d1b28bea913', date:'2026-07-06', start_time:'10:30', service_type:'Paid', vehicle_reg_no, vehicle_model, notes:null}. Suspected cause: (a) POST validator matches start_time against a different shifts table than the one /slots reads, or (b) DB has duplicate shift rows for QuickWheels (GET /slots returns two identical 09:00-18:00 entries) causing the POST matcher to fail. This is the SAME root class of bug as iteration 5 but with a new error message — previously it was rejecting service_type='Two Wheeler', now that we send 'Paid' it rejects on shift availability instead.

minor.issue: Returns two duplicate shift entries ({start_time:'09:00', end_time:'18:00', available:true, ...}) for every date. Frontend now dedupes visually, but the source data should not have duplicates — clean up the QuickWheels schedule/shifts seed rows so only one 09:00-18:00 shift per weekday remains. This may also be the underlying cause of the POST 400 above.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend now sends service_type='Paid' correctly, but backend rejects with 400 'Selected shift is not available'. Blocks the entire automobile booking + subsequent reschedule regression.

action_items: CRITICAL (backend): Fix POST /api/bookings shift-availability matcher for QuickWheels — currently rejects every start_time as 'Selected shift is not available' even when GET /slots marks the shift available=true. Reproduce with any customer JWT → POST /api/bookings {provider_id:'3610a6f1-4cf4-4f03-94c5-b9795ccefd9b', service_id:'5e4a9897-dd6b-4bcc-80db-2d1b28bea913', date:'2026-07-06', start_time:'10:30', service_type:'Paid', vehicle_reg_no:'KA05EF9999'}.

MEDIUM (data cleanup): De-duplicate the QuickWheels shift rows in the schedule table — GET /providers/3610a6f1.../slots?date=2026-07-02 currently returns two identical 09:00-18:00 shifts. Likely the same seed inserted twice.

AFTER FIXES: Re-run the automobile end-to-end (customer→category→QuickWheels→BookSlot→ confirm with Paid+vehicle_reg → /bookings/:id with token + vehicle_reg row) and the reschedule regression, which are the only two remaining unverified flows.
critical_code_review_comments: BookSlot.jsx frontend fixes verified clean: (a) L25 default serviceType='Paid' is correct; (b) L79 dedupes shift-generated times via Array.from(new Set(out)).sort(); (c) L285-299 renders a proper 2-column Paid/Free segmented control with correct data-testids; (d) L99 always sends serviceType || 'Paid' (never falls back to selectedService.service_type). No further frontend changes needed for this feature.

Backend inconsistency: /providers/{id}/slots reports availability using one code path while POST /bookings validates against another. Consolidate onto a single shift-availability function so the UI and API agree. Duplicate-shift rows for QuickWheels are almost certainly the trigger.

Data hygiene: the pre-existing booking c04541dd (seeded via curl in iteration 5) still occupies 2026-07-01 09:00 for customer 9999999999; consider deleting it so retests can use the earliest slot without a 409.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend is now correct for the 3 fixes E1 shipped — do NOT re-verify the segmented control, dedupe, or QuickWheels visibility next iteration; a 30-second smoke is enough. The blocker is entirely backend: POST /api/bookings rejects every automobile shift with 'Selected shift is not available'. Once backend fixes the shift-matcher (and ideally dedupes the QuickWheels shift rows), retest by (a) creating a new booking via UI on any future date, (b) verifying /bookings/:id renders token + vehicle_reg row, and (c) tapping booking-reschedule-btn → pick a new time → reschedule-confirm-btn → verify 'Booking updated' toast and updated time in summary.
rca of the issue: Automobile booking POST is being rejected by backend availability check even though the client-visible /slots endpoint reports the shift as available=true. Frontend payload was verified via response hook: {provider_id, service_id, date, start_time, service_type:'Paid', vehicle_reg_no, vehicle_model, notes:null} — all values well-formed. Test matrix: 2026-07-01 09:00 → 409 (existing booking c04541dd from iter-5); 2026-07-01 15:00 → 400; 2026-07-02 12:45 → 400; 2026-07-06 10:30 → 400. Because /providers/{id}/slots?date=2026-07-02 returns two identical 09:00-18:00 shift objects (duplicate seed rows), the backend POST matcher likely picks the 'wrong' one or fails an internal uniqueness check. Fix: clean up the duplicate shift rows for QuickWheels (id 3610a6f1-4cf4-4f03-94c5-b9795ccefd9b) and/or make the POST /bookings shift-matcher use the same code path as GET /providers/{id}/slots.
